Hi Matt —

Thanks again for agreeing to a joint rehearsal ahead of the marketplace listing next month. We originally penciled a 90-minute runthrough for Sept 17 focused on the end-to-end demo flow, partner handoff, and listing checklist. Quick ask: is there any flexibility to shift that slot by 2 hours later? We have an internal SI architect who needs to join but is blocked until mid-afternoon PST.

Proposed options (all PT):
- Sept 17, 2:00–3:30pm PT (preferred)
- Sept 17, 4:00–5:30pm PT
- Sept 18, 10:00–11:30am PT (backup)

Agenda (high level):
- 2:00–2:10: introductions + goals
- 2:10–2:45: live demo (Redwood + Peregrine flows)
- 2:45–3:10: SI integration + troubleshooting points
- 3:10–3:30: open Q&A + next steps

I attached the runbook (redwood_peregrine_rehearsal_runbook_v1.pdf). Please let us know which option works and who from your side will present the integration bits.

Appreciate it —
Ava

- 2:00pm PT = 5:00pm ET (works for me, might be late for the engineer)
